configuration.purpose: Preserve generic signed10 coefficients as signed-low8 plus256*residual[-2,2]. Pack low coefficients, unpack each signed10-input product, and restore residuals using shifts/adds. This keeps the passing w10a10 precision despite failing uniform INT8 quality.
